name: drag-handle
title: Drag handle
base: lucide GripVertical plus a flat state dot, the command bubble's handle
notes: The bubble's drag handle (drag, or arrow keys; Shift moves 48 px). A flat dot beside the grip: idle is a muted ring, working fills once per save or later sync (never on first load), needs-you is an accent ring only while the passcode form is open. Offline and error stay muted. The neural-net mark is reserved for agent profile icons (design/reserved/agent-avatar), it is not part of the board.
